items.title: 18.4 Predicting Formula and Charge of a Complex Ion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.4 with Table 18.3, printed page 21.

blocks.text: Complex ion ka formula aur charge central metal ion, us ki oxidation state, aur ligands aur un ke charges ko mila kar maloom kiya jata hai. Complex ion ki general form (aam shakal) [M(L)ₓ]±ʸ hai, jahan M central metal ion, L ligand, x ligands ka number (coordination number se tay) aur ±y complex ion ka total charge hai.

blocks.caption: Table 18.3 Complex ion ka formula aur charge maloom karna
rows: Pehle metal (Co), phir ligand (NH₃) aur us ka number (6) subscript mein, sab square brackets [ ] ke andar.
Pehle metal (Fe), phir ligand (CN) aur number (6) subscript mein, brackets [ ] ke andar.
Pehle metal (Ni), phir ligand (CO) aur number (4) subscript mein, brackets [ ] ke andar.
Metal ka charge + (ligands ka number × ligand ka charge): positive sum
Metal ka charge + (ligands ka number × ligand ka charge): negative sum
Metal ka charge + (ligands ka number × ligand ka charge): zero sum

blocks.title: Formula likhna
blocks.text: Pehle metal, phir ligand aur us ka number subscript mein, sab square brackets ke andar; total charge brackets ke bahar superscript mein. Charge = metal ka charge + (ligands ka number × ligand ka charge).

blocks.prompt: Cu²⁺ aur chaar Cl⁻ ligands se banne wale complex ka formula aur charge batayein.

items: General form [M(L)ₓ]±ʸ; charge = metal ka charge + (x × ligand ka charge).
